_V1_PATTERNS: Final = _AppSecurityPatterns(
    api_bypass=re.compile(
        r"^(?:"
        r"|/addons/self/(?!security|update)[^/]+"
        r"|/addons/self/options/config"
        r"|/info"
        r"|/services.*"
        r"|/discovery.*"
        r"|/auth"
        r")$"
    ),
    core_only=re.compile(
        r"^(?:"
        r"/addons/" + RE_SLUG + r"/sys_options"
        r"|/os/ssh/authorized_keys"
        r")$"
    ),
    role_access={
        ROLE_DEFAULT: re.compile(
            r"^(?:"
            r"|/.+/info"
            r")$"
        ),
        ROLE_HOMEASSISTANT: re.compile(
            r"^(?:"
            r"|/.+/info"
            r"|/core/.+"
            r"|/homeassistant/.+"
            r")$"
        ),
        ROLE_BACKUP: re.compile(
            r"^(?:"
            r"|/.+/info"
            r"|/backups.*"
            r")$"
        ),
        ROLE_MANAGER: re.compile(
            r"^(?:"
            r"|/.+/info"
            r"|/addons(?:/" + RE_SLUG + r"/(?!security).+|/reload)?"
            r"|/audio/.+"
            r"|/auth/cache"
            r"|/available_updates"
            r"|/backups.*"
            r"|/cli/.+"
            r"|/core/.+"
            r"|/dns/.+"
            r"|/docker/.+"
            r"|/jobs/.+"
            r"|/hardware/.+"
            r"|/homeassistant/.+"
            r"|/host/.+"
            r"|/mounts.*"
            r"|/multicast/.+"
            r"|/network/.+"
            r"|/observer/.+"
            r"|/os/(?!datadisk/wipe|ssh/authorized_keys).+"
            r"|/refresh_updates"
            r"|/resolution/.+"
            r"|/security/.+"
            r"|/snapshots.*"
            r"|/store.*"
            r"|/supervisor/.+"
            r"|/time/.+"
            r")$"
        ),
        ROLE_ADMIN: re.compile(r".*"),
    },
    no_security_check=re.compile(
        r"^(?:"
        r"|/homeassistant/api/.*"
        r"|/homeassistant/websocket"
        r"|/core/api/.*"
        r"|/core/websocket"
        r"|/supervisor/ping"
        r"|/ingress/[-_A-Za-z0-9]+/.*"
        + _V1_FRONTEND_PATHS
        + r")$"
    ),
)
